title: JSFL fl.activeDocument property missing from runtime
description: Flash 8 JSFL exposes fl.activeDocument as a property alias for fl.getDocumentDOM(). The JsflFl interface in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts (line 3960+) and the makeFlProxy factory (line 4098+) implement getDocumentDOM() but do not expose an activeDocument getter. Any JSFL script that reads fl.activeDocument gets undefined instead of the document proxy, causing silent failures (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined). Fix: add a get activeDocument() { return this.getDocumentDOM(); } getter to both the JsflFl interface and the makeFlProxy implementation. File: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts.
